description:
Edit repos/development-vessel/src/cli.ts and no other file.

In the template seed loop, a result with shape "structuredError" is pushed onto failures unconditionally. One refusal it catches is activity-api declining a duplicate mint, whose detail reads like "refused duplicate mint: 1 existing producer(s) ... route to <id> instead of minting a new Beta(1,1) cell". That refusal is law 3 working as intended, and the post-condition seeding cares about - a producer for the shape exists - is already satisfied.

Measured on a clean first boot: 49 of 119 templates reported failed, of which 40 were this reuse refusal. Because failures.length > 0 triggers process.exit(1), development-vessel-seed.service ends failed and substrate-doctor reports FAILURES on a substrate behaving correctly.

Add an alreadyServed counter. When the structuredError detail matches /duplicate mint|existing producer|already[ _-]?exists/i, increment that counter, log the template with a distinct marker instead of the failure marker, and continue WITHOUT pushing onto failures. Include the count in the final summary line so it stays visible.

Constraints: change only repos/development-vessel/src/cli.ts. Do not modify any import statement or any other file. Genuine failures must still count as failures and must still exit non-zero - specifically auth rejections, and validation rejections such as "Invalid input_shapes: the composition declares a precondition it produces itself".
